subject: Temporary extension request for log retention + backup purge hold
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@medport.com>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: MedPort Security <security@medport.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to temporarily extend log retention + pause scheduled backup purge

Hi Sofia —

We're in the middle of a security investigation spanning several customer incidents. Our internal legal team has asked us to request a temporary extension of the log retention window for data indexed by Redwood for account MedPort Health, and to pause the automated backup purge that is currently scheduled for 2027-06-03. Specific asks: 

- Extend application logs and request/response traces from 90 days to 180 days for this account for the next 45 days.
- Hold (do not delete) backups with snapshot tags mp-prod-2027-* until we confirm closure of the investigation.
- Provide confirmation of the chain-of-custody and deletion evidence once the hold is released.

We appreciate this is outside normal policy — happy to sign a short amendment to the DPA or a one-off statement of work. Please let me know who on your side I should coordinate with.

Thanks,
Elena
Director, Security Operations
MedPort Health

From: sofia_ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@medport.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to temporarily extend log retention + pause scheduled backup purge

Elena —

Thanks for the heads up and the clear ask. We can accommodate a temporary extension and a purge hold, but we need to coordinate across engineering, compliance, and our cloud subprocessors to: 

1) confirm which storage tiers and subprocessors hold the snapshots (GCP persistent snapshots, object storage, and our cold-archive provider),
2) implement a temporary "circuit-breaker" flag so automated purge jobs ignore snapshots tagged mp-prod-2027-* for 45 days, and
3) prepare an auditable deletion runbook to produce proof of deletion once you authorize release.

Karthik — can you confirm feasibility for the circuit-breaker + estimated ops work? Marissa, can you draft a short DPA amendment/letter that covers the limited extension and auditors' evidence needs?

I'll put a calendar slot for an hour tomorrow to triage.

— Sofia
Senior Manager, Security & Trust
Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to temporarily extend log retention + pause scheduled backup purge

Sofia / Marissa —

Quick tech note after reviewing our jobs and subproc contracts: 

- GCP holds incremental snapshots (regional). We need an emergency hold request to GCP contracts to prevent lifecycle rules from deleting older objects. I'll loop in our vendor contact and provide the exact snapshot ids.
- Object-store lifecycle jobs (our internal purge pipeline) run nightly; adding a flag is straightforward — ~3 engineer-hours to add guardrails + tests, and 2 hours of on-call monitoring while hold is active.
- KV caches and ephemeral logs are not part of snapshot retention; we can leave those unchanged.
- For the auditable deletion, we should generate a CSV with snapshot ids, deletion timestamps, operator id, and checksum confirmation. Markus can wire the checksum verification step into the deletion pipeline.

Risk note: Cross-border copies exist for EU redundancy. If MedPort requires cross-border hold policy, we need a sign-off from their data protection officer because of additional data transfer considerations.

I'll prepare a short technical runbook and a list of exact snapshot ids by EOD.

— Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@medport.com>, sofia_ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 12:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to temporarily extend log retention + pause scheduled backup purge

Elena —

We can do a 45-day extension and an accompanying one-off retention amendment tied to your DPA. I'll draft a brief amendment today that covers: scope (MP account only), retention period (extend to 180 days for the 45-day window), purge hold process, evidence obligations (CSV + checksums + operator signoff), and an indemnity carveout for the exceptional hold.

Two items for you: 1) Can your DPO confirm whether the EU copies of backups must remain under the same hold? If yes, please reply-all with an affirmative or provide the DPO contact. 2) Please sign the DocuSign link once I send it — we'll treat the amendment as effective on signature.

Attachments: draft template (internal) attached.

Best,
Marissa
Sr. Counsel, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@medport.com>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: MedPort Security <security@medport.com>, GCP Contracts <gcp-contracts@google.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 15:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to temporarily extend log retention + pause scheduled backup purge

Thanks all — this looks good. Our DPO (Liam O'Connor) confirms EU replicas must be held the same way; CC'ing his personal account per your request. Liam: can you confirm in-thread?

We will sign the amendment once Marissa sends the DocuSign. As for evidence, please include the operator id and checksum in the CSV; our auditors will want a signed statement that deletion procedures were executed after the hold is lifted.

Sofia — can you please include the list of snapshot ids and the estimated timeline to resume normal lifecycle rules? We need that for our change control.

Appreciate the quick response.

— Elena
Director, Security Operations
MedPort Health
